output.headline: McKesson's one deal was a Health IT bolt-on at 25.1x, so it can pay up for this asset, but its record is thin.
output.differentiator: Its median multiple paid, 25.1x, is the highest on the priority list, though from a single deal. Its sub-sector share and margin fit are strong signals.
output.why_them: Prior Health IT bolt-on buyer that paid a premium multiple

acquirer_overview.title: A strategic buyer with one Health IT deal on file
points: McKesson is a strategic buyer whose home sub-sector is Health IT, the same as the target's [B:buyer].
One deal on file, closed in 2017, and none since 2022, so there is no recent activity [T:record, K:recent].
Its profile is not researched and buyer revenue is not researched, so its scale is unconfirmed [V:synergy].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: Sub-sector and margin fit are strong; recency and depth are not
points: Share of its deals in the target's sub-sector is the strongest factor; margin close to what it usually buys is a strong factor [S:sector_share, S:margin_fit].
Its one deal carried the Technology Capability tag, found on only 10% of deals in the file, and Platform Build (1 of 1) [M:technology_capability, M:platform_build].
The $300M target is not bigger than any deal it has done, a slight factor in its favour [S:not_bigger].

precedent_activity.title: One $405M bolt-on in 2017 is the only precedent
points: Southeast Medical Informatics: $405M Health IT bolt-on, 2017, at 25.1x EBITDA and 5.40x revenue; it closed [D:MA-2017-0106].
That deal sits in the comparable size band of $150M-$600M (1 of 1) [K:size_band].
It was in the Southwest; McKesson has no deal in the target's National region [T:record, K:by_region].

valuation_context.title: The median is the anchor; McKesson's past multiple sits above it
points: 13 comparable same-sub-sector deals of $150M-$600M: 19.4x at the 25th percentile, 21.4x median, 23.3x at the 75th [V:comps].
The target's 25.0% margin beats the comps' median of 22.2% but not their top quarter, so the 50th percentile is defensible [V:comps].
McKesson paid 25.1x in its one deal. Cost-synergy headroom is $14M-$23M; buyer revenue is not researched [V:comps, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Thin record
risk_flags.concern: Only one deal, in 2017, and none since 2022.
risk_flags.mitigant: That deal was a same-sub-sector bolt-on that closed.
risk_flags.reality: One data point supports the 25.1x price marker but not a pattern [T:record, K:recent, D:MA-2017-0106].

risk_flags.title: No regional footprint
risk_flags.concern: No deal in the target's National region; its one deal was in the Southwest.
risk_flags.mitigant: Region is a neutral point, not a signal against.
risk_flags.reality: Region fit is unproven, and its profile and revenue are not researched [T:record, V:synergy].

risk_flags.title: Weak position in the process
risk_flags.concern: It ranks 10th of 10 on the priority list, with a likelihood of 3.7%.
risk_flags.mitigant: Its sub-sector share is the strongest factor in its favour.
risk_flags.reality: Having bought from this kind of seller is a slight factor against it [R:rank, S:sector_share, S:own_fit_s].

conviction.rationale: Low because only 1 deal sits in the target's own sub-sector and none in its region. Sub-sector share and margin fit favour McKesson, but a single 2017 deal is thin evidence [C:conviction, T:record].
